about: [O1b critic] the river as a stranger meets it: off the south quay at a plain stretch (not at the steps), the eye in the water, look round (is the way out seen?), swim straight back at the quay wall, then hands off for 60 s (idle: what happens?), then swim along the wall looking for a way up.
